title: Susammuṭṭhā
text: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || Yesaṃ dhammā susammuṭṭhā || paravādesu nīyare || suttā te nappabujjhanti || kālo tesaṃ pabujjhitun ti || || Yesaṃ dhammā asammuṭṭhā || paravādesu na nīyare || te sambuddhā sammadaññā || caranti visame saman ti || ||
